rationale: First-shot default-HP mlp_classifier beat kernel_logreg's current default on avg_ann (+18.2% vs -3.9%) — model is positive-EV but oversamples picks (WR 29.7%, 256 trades vs kernel_logreg's 202). Failing 7/7 on WR<40% floor, but every window posts within 4-12pp of the bar, and W1 hit +175% ann at threshold 0 (top-K fallback). The HP space (alpha 1e-4..1e-2, hidden_layer_1 32..256, activation relu/tanh, batch_size 128..512) gives train mode 10k+ configs and an obvious dial — higher alpha + smaller hidden width should sharpen selection and lift WR. Pivots away from kernel_logreg which has 15 train iters since #819 with no movement beyond 4/7.
